You know the kind, they come in packs that are pink, white and brown (strawberry, vanilla and chocolate), little wafers with the powdery filling?

This one was made totally on accident. I played around and tried to make something - anything that would use up some of this Zen Garden flavoring I had and was never going to use any of. There's no strawberry in this mix, but damned if it doesn't come across as smelling and tasting like one of those pink sugar wafers - like a semi-cheap, sweet artificial strawberry.

Pink Cookie Wafer

4% FA Cookie

2% FA Marzipan

2% FA Zen Garden

And that's it. I don't know what it is about the flavors that work together, but I stumbled upon it and thought to share it. It's not exactly my cup of tea, but the wife really digs it and likes the lingering smell that it leaves.

Recommendations for playing with it: I imagine you could always throw in a smidge of actual strawberry to really punch that flavor through. The cookie does a good job of giving it a bready feel, but I feel like it might be alright to throw in a few drops of AP. Perhaps a sweetener/bakery ingredient would serve well in here, like a Frosted Donut or maybe even Biscuit. FA Joy might work well as a compliment flavor as well.

Happy vaping, and happy holidays!
